narrative.text:
I’ll serialize admission for held traffic, keeping the unconfigured flush path unchanged. I’ll also add the explicit tool-hint override warning, remove the duplicate AST check, and correct the report wording about required connections’ lack of toolset presence.
The new burst/order tests failed on the starting revision and now pass. Held traffic drains sequentially, waits for slots still occupied by pre-pause callbacks, and preserves pause/reconnect boundaries. The hint override warning and single AST check are also committed. Both Node versions are now getting fresh full gates.
